text.description_html:
PDQ 429019-605, Polished Brass Panic Bar Double Door Strike Plate

For double doors - Use when installing a PDQ 4200V Vertical Rod Panic Device on one door and a PDQ 4200 Rim Exit Panic Device on the other door.

Features and Specifications of the Panic Device Strike Plate:

  • Overall Width: 2-3/4"
  • Overall Height: 2-3/4"
  • Finish: Polished Brass
  • Packaged with mounting screws.

Sold Individually
